component.name: Ship Game
component.summary: Sailing combat powered by DarkPlaces QuakeC

description.p: Ship Game is an immersive sailing combat vertical slice running on the DarkPlaces Quake engine with custom QuakeC gameplay: wind-driven sailing, weather (including tornado and tsunami intensity), ballistic cannons, hull collisions, and AI ships.
This Flatpak ships the DarkPlaces engine, the Ship Game QuakeC mod, and free LibreQuake id1 data (pak0/pak1). It does not redistribute proprietary id Software Quake pak files.
Bundle LibreQuake free id1 data so DarkPlaces no longer shows the required-files / basedir dialog.
